Did a whole town really dance until people dropped?
A woman named Frau Troffea stepped into the street...
Within a week, dozens of people had joined her.
By August, some records say hundreds were dancing.
So the city built a stage and hired musicians.
Records from the time say dancers collapsed from exhaustion...
So what was really going on?
Historians think it was mass panic.
The city was starving and sick, and people feared a saint's curse that made you dance.
The fear spread from mind to mind...
In September, the dancers were taken to a shrine to pray.
